title: Zesty Golden Filipino Italian Fennel Sausages Skewers
description: A kid-friendly Filipino dish featuring Italian fennel sausages, deep-fried to a golden crisp, served on skewers. This satvik-friendly recipe is perfect for a light and salty snack.
instructions: Cut the Italian fennel sausages into 1-inch pieces and set aside.
In a shallow dish, mix together the flour and cornstarch.
In a separate dish, beat the eggs.
In another dish, place the breading crumbs.
Dip each sausage piece into the flour mixture, then the eggs, and finally the breading crumbs, coating evenly.
Heat the vegetable oil in a deep frying pan to 350 degrees Fahrenheit.
Deep-fry the breaded sausage pieces in batches until golden brown, about 3-4 minutes per batch.
Remove the fried sausage pieces from the oil and place on paper towels to drain excess oil.
Thread 2-3 fried sausage pieces onto each bamboo skewer.
Serve the skewers hot and sprinkle with salt to taste.
